name: Math Operation
description: It can also be used under the round keyword to get a rounded output rather than a decimal value.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword is used to perform a mathematical operation on two inputs/keywords. The output of math operation keyword is a float.

It can also be used under the round keyword to get a rounded output rather than a decimal value.

![Example](./images/img-1632312404.png)

In the example shared above, we are adding 5 and 15, so the output will be 20
